title: Private Pedicab Tour of DC Monuments and Memorials
includes: Expert Tour Guide (one of the top guides in all of Washington)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
With a top guide of Washington, you and your family can see the major DC Monuments and Memorials, the White House, at your own pace, with no bus-filled crowding or walking — and no waiting. You'll be protected from the weather, including rain, snow and sun. Kid-friendly, and your dogs are most welcome! This is the best option for anyone with a mobility impairment. 

We also conduct night tours, which usually include all the amazing lit-up sights.

Important Information:
• A minimum of 2 guests is required per booking.
• For safety and rider comfort, the pedicab is recommended for a combined passenger weight of up to 700 lbs. The pedicab’s absolute maximum capacity is 850 lbs.
